# 📋 HydroCast Issue Templates Directory

This directory contains the standardized **GitHub Issue Templates** for the **HydroCast Panchganga Flood Forecasting Platform**, aligned with academic, operational, and disaster intelligence standards.

---

## 🗂️ Template Catalog

| Template File | Issue Type | Primary Audience | Default Labels |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| [`01_bug_report.md`](./01_bug_report.md) | **Software Defect / Bug** | Developers, Maintainers, QA | `bug`, `needs-triage` |
| [`02_feature_request.md`](./02_feature_request.md) | **Feature & Architectural RFC** | Hydrologists, SREs, Product | `enhancement`, `needs-triage` |
| [`03_sensor_telemetry_incident.md`](./03_sensor_telemetry_incident.md) | **IoT RTDAS Telemetry Anomaly** | Field Engineers, Sensor Ops | `telemetry`, `needs-triage` |
| [`04_hydrology_recalibration.md`](./04_hydrology_recalibration.md) | **Hydrologic Calibration & WRD Datum** | Hydrologists, WRD Engineers | `hydrology`, `needs-triage` |
| [`05_security_incident.md`](./05_security_incident.md) | **Security Advisory** | Security Researchers, Admins | `security`, `needs-triage` |

---

## 🔒 Security Policy
For zero-day or high-severity vulnerabilities affecting on-premises municipal flood infrastructure, please adhere to [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) and report directly via encrypted channels or email to **`satwikcccss@gmail.com`**.
